newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Explosion in Tel Aviv, casualties - radio.
newsitem.headline: Explosion in Tel Aviv, casualties - radio.

text.p: Israel Radio said on Friday there was an explosion in central Tel Aviv and it had reports of casualties.
It said it did not know the cause of the blast.
A police spokeswoman said there were wounded but she had no details.
A radio reporter said the blast tore through the Apropos cafe on Ben Gurion Street in the heart of Tel Aviv.
Ambulances and police rushed to the scene.
"The garden of the cafe is completely destroyed," the reporter said.
